122262.overview: A M.U.G.E.N. fighter based in the Dragon Ball Z universe, with quite a lot of characters, who, I've been assured are all very distinct and have interesting backstories. So that's nice.

142520.overview: Dino Crisis MUGEN is a fan-made action game, developed using the M.U.G.E.N. engine. Play as Regina or Dylan, either solo or co-op, as they fight their way through waves of hungry dinosaurs. With a unique premise and an in-game menu system for weapons and items, something rarely seen in MUGEN projects, the game was well-received by fans in the community for its originality. The game allows the player to enjoy the experience as Regina or Dylan, and also has a cooperative mode that divides the game screen.

164778.overview: I have assembled quite a huge roster of DC-universe and Marvel-universe characters, songs and stages. In this version, you will need to win two fights to win a fight. New Characters: Added characters, from the original 252 characters in the game (present in Superheroes 2000 V4.3, the mod of wich i modified before replacing the screenpack with my own and adding everything from scratch- to not irritate that mods creator), to 304 characters in the game, and 413 characters in the char-folder. I have not only added characters, but also replaced some characters with other better versions of these characters- or with completely new ones. The best characters are already in-game, and the lesser characters are not. New Stages: Added stages, from the original 92 stages, to 112 stages in this new version. New music: Added music from the original 92 songs, to like 108 songs or something like that.

463123.overview:
All your favorite DC and Marvel characters have come together for the ultimate battle.

Who wins a fight between Superman and Hulk? Who wins between Batman and Ironman? Peacemaker vs Captain America..!

Play as any characters you want in 1 vs 1, or tag or simultaneous battles! Use your keyboard, plug in a controller - anyway you want, just configure and start playing!
